verdict.rationale: Rollbar documents official SDKs across many platforms. Rollbar.js covers client-side and server-side JavaScript, including React, Angular, Express and Next.js. Backend SDKs are shown for Ruby (gem), Rails/Django, .NET (including Blazor client-side) and PHP/Magento2, where the module 'should automatically report all PHP errors and exceptions'. missing for 10: explicit evidence of mobile SDKs (only an Apple Unified Logging module for RollbarNotifier hints at Apple platforms), explicit documentation of automatic uncaught-error capture beyond the Magento module, independent/hands-on corroboration.
